text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Federal government will soon disclose the action it is to take on universities, closed due to a lecturers' strike.
- Eleven companies have now been licensed by the National Communications Commission to provide telecommunications value-added services including pay-phone and internet connections.
- Chinese firm bids for Nigeria's oil fields.
- Scarcity of application forms has clouded the public offer of 66.576 million shares in First Bank after divestment by Standard Chartered Bank of London.
- Deal may have been proposed to list part of Nigeria's $21.66 billion Paris Club debt on the Nigerian Stock Exchange as par bonds, Thisday checks reveal.
